maria_support: Flagging customer case C-2243 — hosted API returning 5xx/504s for the last ~8m. p95 latency jumped to 6.2s. request queue_depth gauge on pool-03 hit ~1,200 and continuous-batcher backlog is visible.

kevin_sre: I see the same in graphite and tracer. Alert rule triggered: ingress.queue_depth > 1000 (5m). Gateway logs show repeated "dequeue timeout" and "no available batcher". example trace: trace/0a1b2c3d.

tom_eng: Can someone paste a minimal curl we can use to repro in staging? I'll spin up a debug session.

maria_support: Quick repro we used against hosted: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"open-llm-large","input":"'$(printf 'x%.0s' {1..20000})'"}'
```
This aligns with tenant=brightdoc-prod sending long-seq concurrent requests. Sample log lines: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:18Z] gateway.go:423 dequeue timeout, enqueueDepth=1214, maxQueue=1024
[2026-03-15T14:22:19Z] batcher.go:117 waiting for slot, pending=312
[2026-03-15T14:22:20Z] kvcache.go:89 coldpath miss, warming kv shards (tenant=brightdoc-prod)
```

sara_ops: Confirmed customer issued ~14k long-seq requests over ~2m window with high concurrency from several client IPs. They did not backoff/retry properly. Our early-reject is configured but their seq_len puts many on the coldpath and KV warmups amplified latency.

kevin_sre: Short-term mitigation applied: (1) lowered per-tenant inflight cap to 100 for that tenant (gateway policy) (2) enabled early-reject for seq_len > 8192 (3) manually boosted batcher count on pool-03 (scale_policy override: min=6,max=12).

tom_eng: I pushed a small routing fallback: when queue_depth > 800 for a tenant, route to a smaller model variant (less memory/cost) to keep throughput. Pushed as canary: @deploy-bot canary-20260315-01.

deploy-bot: canary-20260315-01 deployed to pool-03: version rwinf-2.1.4-hotfix.

maria_support: After throttling and canary fallback, customer errors dropped to ~2% and p95 back under 500ms. Customer agreed to reduce concurrency.

kevin_sre: Follow-ups: (a) add autoscale headroom flag for coldpath bursts, (b) implement per-tenant burst-protection (sticky early-reject thresholds), (c) update runbook trigger: "queue_depth > 800 -> emergency-shed + oncall paging".

sara_ops: I'm adding runbook notes and creating ticket INF-783 to track engineering follow-ups and runbook changes.

infra-bot: incident annotation: classification=ingress_queue_spillover severity=high start_ts=5412346789 end_ts=5412346933 alerted_by=ingress.queue_depth.rule

maria_support: Thanks team — marking this thread for postmortem. I'll attach customer timeline and the curl repro in the PM. :thumbsup:
